comments.quote: 民宿的整體環境和設計非常好，外面泳池特別乾淨，多肉養得很好，下雨天在民宿裏擺爛也很舒服。房間很乾凈，老闆老闆娘人都很好，很熱情。小狗開心特別粘人，非常可愛。早餐也很好吃。距離庾村5km，距離龍潭300m左右，自駕遊很舒適。
comments.author: Guest User
comments.quoteEn: The setting and the design are both very good, the pool outside is remarkably clean and the succulents are well looked after. Doing absolutely nothing here in the rain was comfortable. Very clean rooms and the couple are lovely and welcoming. Their dog Kaixin is affectionate and a delight. Breakfast was good. Five kilometres from Yucun and about three hundred metres from the Longtan, so it is easy if you drive.
